Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Concrete Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Concrete Services specializes in the installation and repair of concrete structures, including foundations, driveways, sidewalks, and commercial flooring. We adhere to local environmental regulations and industry standards, sourcing materials exclusively from compliant suppliers. Our skilled team is trained in safety protocols to minimize jobsite injuries, and we maintain rigorous quality control procedures to prevent faulty workmanship. Additionally, we implement best practices for the proper disposal of concrete washout and managing dust emissions to mitigate potential pollution risks. Our commitment to quality and compliance ensures durability in our projects while safeguarding the environment.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 15, 2022, a loss occurred when a concrete mixer malfunctioned, resulting in a property damage claim of $5,000. The claim was reported and closed successfully, with all repairs completed by August 10, 2022. Another incident happened on March 5, 2023, where a worker suffered a minor injury on-site due to a slip, leading to a claim of $10,000. The claim is currently open, with ongoing treatment and rehabilitation for the worker.
